calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-24-2010 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Judge: Richard B. Ulmer, Jr., Clerk: S. Ravinantpapricha, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Connie Chan, Esq. for and with the Petitioner Jin Jiao Yu, as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Hai Yuan Ruan. Ms. Chan also served as a Cantonese Interpreter for Ms. Yu.
Party and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No appearance by Co-Petitioner (minor's father) Da Chun Ruan, but signed the Petition consented to the name change of the minor.

Proof of Publication in the file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Minor's Name to: Andy Haiyuan Ruan

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
